verdict.rationale: Namecheap is a registrar and hosting provider, so letting customers choose a data storage region or residency is a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such a choice. The items cover the API, RDAP records, the Terraform provider, the Go SDK and community account-security anecdotes, and none of them mention selecting a data region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
